lines.en: Something tells me that the key to moving forward lies somewhere between the ribs of a young girl, and that if I carefully remove it without damaging the shell that I can become normal again.
lines.zh: 有什么东西告诉我:前进的钥匙,就藏在一个年轻女孩的肋骨之间;而只要小心翼翼地把它取出来、不伤到外壳,我就能重新变回正常人。

lines.en: Or for the first time. Or for the last time. Or for a time I can’t describe because time is just a construct, but an ineffective one as I can’t recall a single moment in which it actually functioned the way it’s meant to.
lines.zh: : 又或者,是第一次。又或者,是最后一次。又或者,是一段我无法描述的时光——因为时间只是一种建构,而且是一种失效的建构,我想不起任何一个它真正按预期运作的瞬间。

lines.en: Or the way we meant it to. Or the way we want it to. Or any way at all because, while I grow older mentally, the bodies I long to enrapture don’t add any inches that I’m not personally forcing into them.
lines.zh: : 或者按「我们」预期的方式。或者按「我们」想要的方式。或者随便哪种方式——因为,尽管我的心智在老去,我渴望拥抱的那些身体,却不会自己长出哪怕一寸——除非是我亲手强塞进去的。

lines.en: Somehow or another, we wind up here — my least favorite room in Tsukioka Manor and the one in which I’d want to be buried upon death as it would be equal parts poetic and tragic.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么,我们来到了这里——月冈公馆里我最不喜欢的房间,也是我死后愿意埋葬于其中的房间;因为它一半是诗,一半是悲剧。

lines.en: But that’s kind of just the way I am now — a mix of somber undertones and pity-pleas that even the most righteous of onlookers can’t help but raise an eyebrow at.
lines.zh: : 不过,这大概就是如今的我——阴郁的底色和乞怜的哀求混在一起,连最正义的旁观者都不禁皱眉。

lines.en: It’s just blood and sunset as far as the eye can see, casting a neon glow on an unfortunate torch-bearer and the one he subconsciously wants to set ablaze.
lines.zh: : 目之所及,唯有血与落日,给一个不幸的执炬者、和他下意识想点燃的那个人,镀上一层霓虹的光。

lines.en: Do not mock me, for I am but a bird with a missing voice. All the songs and psalms I want to share with you will stay locked in a journal I buried in eiderdown ‘neath the leftmost center attic floorboard.
lines.zh: : 不要嘲笑我,我只是一只失去声音的鸟。我想与你分享的所有歌与诗篇,都会被锁进一本日记——埋在阁楼最左侧中间那块地板下,裹着鸭绒。

lines.en: I bite down on my tongue to try and wake myself back up, but it’s another sensation that halts this narration.
lines.zh: : 我咬住舌头,试图把自己唤醒,但打断这段旁白的,是另一种感觉。

lines.en: A young girl with eyes like muddied honeycomb — and its sugary voice that makes her feel less like a human and more like a sweet, little it.
lines.zh: : 一个女孩,眼睛像掺了泥的蜂巢——她那甜腻的嗓音,让她不太像人,更像一个甜甜的、小小的「它」。

lines.en: : You said Mother has already shown you this room once before?
lines.zh: : 你说妈妈以前带你看过这个房间?

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Do you like it here? Is that why you wanted to come back?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢这里吗?所以才想回来?

lines.en: : You know, it’s really weird. They say the sakura always bloom in spring, but it’s been spring for a while now and this is still the only tree I’ve seen.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,真的很怪。都说樱花在春天开,可春天已经来了好一阵子,这依然是我见过的唯一一棵。

lines.en: : I wonder how mother manages to keep it so perfect all year long?
lines.zh: : 我好奇妈妈是怎么让它一年四季都保持完美的?

lines.en: : Climate control or something like that. Or hell, maybe it’s just magic. If you can teleport people, I don’t even want to think of what Tsubasa might be capable of.
lines.zh: : 温控设备之类的吧。或者干脆是魔法。既然有人能传送人,我可不想想象 Tsubasa 还能干什么。

lines.en: We inch closer to the infinite tree and I feel inclined to cover our eyes in duct tape.
lines.zh: : 我们一点点靠近那棵无限的树,而我很想用胶带把我们的眼睛封上。

lines.en: I can taste sewer water on my tongue, but mistake my dislike for disgust and have to stop myself from regurgitating my breakfast and several bits of the Corey Worm all over an expensive dress.
lines.zh: : 我舌头上尝到下水道水的味道,却把「不喜欢」误认成「厌恶」,不得不拼命忍住——不能把早餐和几块科里虫,吐到一条昂贵的裙子上。

lines.en: For this white-fronted parrot is not the one you’ve come to abhor nor the one you hate to love — it’s a new one. One that crashed into the window of a moving car and is now minutes away from death.
lines.zh: : 因为这只白额鹦鹉,不是你渐渐憎恶的那只,也不是你恨着爱着的那只——它是一只新的。一只撞上行驶中汽车车窗、离死亡只剩几分钟的。

lines.en: It’s just blood and sunset as far as the eye can see, casting a sickening glow on one particular, poisonous fruit that I’d stay away from most days.
lines.zh: : 目之所及,唯有血与落日,给一颗特别的、有毒的果实镀上令人作呕的光——大多数日子里,我都会离它远远的。

lines.en: But I don’t know how else to detach my mouth from metal grates. And a new taste might be all I can do to rewrite the one I dislike or disgust.
lines.zh: : 可我不知道还能怎么把我的嘴从铁格栅上摘下来。而换一种新的味道,也许是我唯一能做的、改写「不喜欢」或「厌恶」的方式。

lines.en: Today is unlike all the other days. Today I am free to do as I please under the shadow of a former lover.
lines.zh: : 今天和所有其他日子都不一样。今天,我可以在旧情人的阴影下为所欲为。

lines.en: To make her jealous sounds even sweeter than muddied honeycomb.
lines.zh: : 让她嫉妒,听起来比掺泥的蜂巢还要甜。

lines.en: : Do you think you’ll continue to tutor me after today, Jeeves?
lines.zh: : 今天之后,你还会继续给我上课吗,Jeeves?

lines.en: : It’s “Sensei” while we’re here, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 在这里要叫「Sensei」,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Sorry. Do you think you’ll continue to tutor me after today, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。今天之后,你还会继续给我上课吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Why do you ask? Are you actually having a good time?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么问?你居然玩得开心?

lines.en: : All things considered, I actually think you’re a rather boring individual.
lines.zh: : 综合来看,我 actually 觉得你是个相当无聊的人。

lines.en: : But I suppose there are some qualities I like.
lines.zh: : 但我想,你身上也有几处我喜欢的地方。

lines.en: : We will need to work on your attire, though. If you’ll be coming to the manor more often, you’ll need to look the part.
lines.zh: : 不过你的着装需要改进。如果你要常来公馆,就得穿得像样。

lines.en: : The last thing we want is the servants discovering there are clothes apart from what we provide them. And I can only imagine what sort of chaos would break loose if we couldn’t immediately identify the staff.
lines.zh: : 我们最不想看到的,就是仆人们发现:原来世上除了我们发的制服,还有别的衣服。而如果我无法一眼认出哪些是 staff,我都能想象会闹出多大的乱子。

lines.en: : Yeah. All of those human beings having freedom sounds awfully exhausting, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊。「所有人类都拥有自由」这种事,听起来累得要命,不是吗?

lines.en: : I’m glad you see things my way, Jeeves. I knew I could count on you.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你和我看法一致,Jeeves。我就知道能指望你。

lines.en: : Hey, how about we have our next lesson on sarcasm? That way, you’ll be able to tell whenever I’m subtly belittling you for being a spoiled princess.
lines.zh: : 嘿,下一节课我们学反讽怎么样?这样,每当我拐弯抹角地贬低你是个被宠坏的公主时,你就能听出来了。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with being a spoiled princess?
lines.zh: : 被宠坏的公主有什么不好?

lines.en: : The fact that you’ve likely never been disciplined at any point in your life.
lines.zh: : 不好在你这辈子,恐怕从来没有被管教过。

lines.en: : But I’m disciplined all the time. Just last week, Mother took away my Ferrari for two hours. It was completely uncalled for.
lines.zh: : 可我一直都有被管教啊。就在上周,妈妈把我的法拉利没收了两个小时。完全没有必要。

lines.en: : Why do you even own a sports car? You can’t drive.
lines.zh: : 你为什么会有跑车?你又不会开车。

lines.en: : But I’ll be able to one day. And until then, I can use it to pretend I’m Xenia Onatopp chasing after James Bond in the 1995 hit American spy movie, “GoldenEye.”
lines.zh: : 但总有一天会的。在那之前,我可以用它假装自己是 Xenia Onatopp——在 1995 年美国热门谍战片《黄金眼》里追杀詹姆斯·邦德的那位。

lines.en: : Well, I guess I can add action movies to the list of surprising interests held by Tsukasa Tsukioka.
lines.zh: : 好吧,看来我可以在「月冈月司令人意外的爱好清单」上,再添一项动作片了。

lines.en: : I did not give you permission to make lists about me, Jeeves. Everyone knows that 90%% of lists end in assassination attempts.
lines.zh: : 我没有批准你给我列清单,Jeeves。所有人都知道,90%% 的清单最终都以刺杀收场。

lines.en: : I’d be completely disadvantaged right now if I’d not spent so much time practicing my role as a femme fatale.
lines.zh: : 如果我没花那么多时间练习「蛇蝎美人」,现在就会完全处于劣势。

lines.en: : Any attempt on my life will be sure to end in equal or greater tragedy for those who...attempt it. So you.
lines.zh: : 任何企图谋害我的人,最终招来的悲剧只会相等或更大。对那些……企图者。也就是你。

lines.en: : Wait! That’s why you had a change of heart, isn’t it?! You’re attempting to get close to me so you can kill me! I knew that statistic about lists was true! Even if I made it up.
lines.zh: : 等等!所以你转变态度是这个原因吧?!你是想接近我、然后杀了我!我就知道那份关于清单的统计是真的!虽然是我编的。

lines.en: : Our lesson after the one on sarcasm will be about how to stop talking.
lines.zh: : 反讽课之后的下一课,是如何停止说话。

lines.en: : If I’m not already dead by then. And who even knows at this point?
lines.zh: : 如果我到时候还没死的话。而且事到如今,谁知道呢?

lines.en: : Serves you right for blindly trusting me. You could be walking alongside a very dangerous man right now and you wouldn’t even know it.
lines.zh: : 你盲目信任我,活该。你现在可能正和一个非常危险的男人并肩走,而你甚至察觉不到。

lines.en: : It’s better than walking by myself.
lines.zh: : 总比独自走强。

lines.en: : ...Is it?
: Yeah. Because, even if you’re boring, you’re still less boring than an imaginary friend.
lines.zh: : 是。因为,哪怕你很无聊,你也比一个假想的朋友有趣。

lines.en: : And all 143 of your henchmen?
lines.zh: : 那你的 143 个手下呢?

lines.en: : Oh, do they count as people? I wasn’t really sure.
lines.zh: : 哦,他们算「人」吗?我不太确定。

lines.en: : They do. And I get that you’re lonely. I’ve known that since National Tsukasa Day. But you shouldn’t be looking at the time you spend with me as a solution to that.
lines.zh: : 算。而且我知道你孤独。从全国月司日起我就知道了。但你不应该把我们相处的时间,当成解决它的办法。

lines.en: : If I’m going to be your tutor, that’s all I’m going to be. Not your friend. Not someone you can lean on when you feel left out.
lines.zh: : 如果我要当你家庭教师,那我就只是家庭教师。不是你的朋友。不是你感到被冷落时可以依靠的人。

lines.en: : Just a tutor.
lines.zh: : 只是家教。

lines.en: : Why are you acting so serious all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你为什么突然这么严肃?

lines.en: : Come to think of it, you’ve been very strange ever since we left the bedroom, Jeeves.
lines.zh: : 说起来,从离开那间卧室开始,你就一直很怪,Jeeves。

lines.en: : Because I don’t want this spiraling into anything else. And I don’t like when you show your weaknesses and vulnerabilities to me.
lines.zh: : 因为我不想让这件事升级成任何别的东西。而且我不喜欢你向我展示你的弱点和软肋。

lines.en: : Being lonely is a weakness?
lines.zh: : 孤独是弱点吗?

lines.en: : Of course. Anything someone can leverage to take advantage of you is a weakness.
lines.zh: : 当然。任何能被人拿来利用你的东西,都是弱点。

lines.en: : Huh...I suppose that’s correct. I never really thought of it that way.
lines.zh: : 唔……或许没错。我从来没那样想过。

lines.en: : But wouldn’t that mean you’re showing me one of your weaknesses too?
lines.zh: : 但那不意味着,你也在向我展示你的一个弱点吗?

lines.en: : You’re lonely as well. Aren’t you, Jeeves?
lines.zh: : 你也一样孤独。对吧,Jeeves?

lines.en: : It’s not as if I’m paying you for this. Which means you must have been completely out of other people to talk to if you had to call me for something to do.
lines.zh: : 又不是我付钱请你陪我的。这说明,你必须打电话叫我「找点事做」的时候,身边已经完全没有任何可以说话的人了。

lines.en: : But that’s okay. As the backup heiress to the Tsukioka Foundation, I’m used to being the “failsafe.”
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。作为月冈基金会的候补继承人,我早已习惯当那个「备用保险」。

lines.en: : Don’t call yourself a “failsafe,” Tsukasa. You’re better than that.
lines.zh: : 别把自己叫作「备用保险」,Tsukasa。你比那好得多。

lines.en: : No one else seems to think so. The only reason I even used that word is because I’ve heard other people say it about me.
lines.zh: : 别人可不这么认为。我会用这个词,唯一的原因就是我听别人这么说过我。

lines.en: : What other people? Everyone you associate with is in this building.
lines.zh: : 哪些别人?你来往的所有人,都在这栋楼里。

lines.en: : Exactly. They’re the ones saying it.
lines.zh: : exactly。说这话的就是他们。

lines.en: : We have many servants, Jeeves. And not all of them have taken a vow of silence like my henchmen.
lines.zh: : 我们有很多仆人,Jeeves。而他们并不都像我的手下那样发过沉默誓。

lines.en: : They say all sorts of things to one another when they think no one’s listening. And what I’ve learned from that is that I’m not very popular around here.
lines.zh: : 他们在以为没人听的时候,彼此什么都聊。而我从中学到的是:我在这栋楼里不受欢迎。

lines.en: : So it only makes sense to assume that I’m a “failsafe” for you as well.
lines.zh: : 所以顺理成章,我也可以假设,对你来说我也是「备用保险」。

lines.en: : So, I appreciate your time and all...but we both know you’re only here because Nee-sama is busy.
lines.zh: : 所以,我很感谢你抽出时间……但我们心知肚明,你来只是因为 Nee-sama 忙。

lines.en: : Are they actually saying things like that about you?
lines.zh: : 他们真的那样说你?

lines.en: : Like I said, I’m used to it.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的,我习惯了。

lines.en: : But thankfully, I can fire them whenever I want. And I get peace of mind in the fact that their futures are in the palms of my hands.
lines.zh: : 不过万幸,我随时可以开除他们。而且想到他们的未来都攥在我的手心,我就心安。

lines.en: : Just as yours is. So do remember to be very nice to me even if I am your second choice.
lines.zh: : 正如你的未来攥在我手里。所以请务必记得对我好一点——哪怕我只是你的第二选择。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you have to deal with that, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 你要应付那些,我很难过,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Everyone should feel safe inside their own home.
lines.zh: : 每个人都应该在自己的家里感到安全。

lines.en: : It’s okay, Jeeves!
lines.zh: : 没事的,Jeeves!

lines.en: : Besides, it’s not like I don’t hear them talking about more interesting things too!
lines.zh: : 再说了,我又不是听不到他们说些更有趣的东西!

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如?

lines.en: : For example...there are rumors of a ghost in the manor. And they say she haunts this very room...
lines.zh: : 比如……公馆里有鬼魂的传闻。而且他们说,她就缠在这间屋子里……

lines.en: : Oh! Don’t you have a ghost following you as well, Jeeves? Can you ask it if it sees the one that haunts the manor? Mother won’t let me hire an exorcist. She says they’re all con artists.
lines.zh: : 哦!你不也有一个跟着你的鬼魂吗,Jeeves?能不能帮我问问它,看不看得见缠着公馆的这位?妈妈不让我请驱魔师。她说他们全是骗子。

lines.en: : What else do they say about the ghost here?
lines.zh: : 他们还说过这里的鬼什么?

lines.en: : Hm? Oh. Right.
lines.zh: : 嗯?哦。对。

lines.en: : Some say that she’s the original gardener from when the manor was first built...and that she died beneath that very tree.
lines.zh: : 有人说,她是公馆初建时的第一任园丁……死在那棵树下。

lines.en: : But others say she wasn’t from the manor at all. They say she had a connection to that tree from before it was brought here.
lines.zh: : 但也有人说,她根本不属于公馆。他们说,在这棵树被搬来之前,她就与它有某种联结。

lines.en: : Some say she’s still buried beneath it. And that the only reason she’s haunting us is because her baby wasn’t buried with her...
lines.zh: : 还有人说,她仍然埋在树下。而她缠着我们的唯一原因是:她的孩子没有和她埋在一起……

lines.en: : I’m not sure which one to believe, but I don’t think you can ever be too safe when it comes to ghosts, Jeeves. So if you know any exorcists-
lines.zh: : 我不知道该信哪一种,但说到鬼魂,再小心也不为过,Jeeves。所以你要是认识什么驱魔师——

lines.en: Let them exorcise these cursed thoughts — the ones that always bring you back to me.
lines.zh: : 让他们驱走这些被诅咒的念头——那些总是把你带回我身边的念头。

lines.en: When these moments of untapped beauty disguised as the plucking of unripe fruit on branches stripped from Yggdrasil scrape against your windows.
lines.zh: : 当这些未经开采的美、伪装成「从被剥自世界树的枝头摘下青涩果实」的动作,刮擦你的窗棂。

lines.en: When you remove yourself from the grasp of your deathbed to press your fingers to the glass and watch, terrified of what lurks beneath the leaves and that violent, whispered wind.
lines.zh: : 当你从临终的病榻上挣脱、把手指按上玻璃张望,惊恐于树叶之下潜伏的东西,和那阵狂暴的低语之风。

lines.en: Let all of these impurities be buried ‘neath the leftmost center attic floorboard, dressed in eiderdown doused in my old perfume.
lines.zh: : 让所有这些不洁,被埋进阁楼最左侧中间的地板之下,裹上浸透我旧日香水的鸭绒。

lines.en: Come, Aki-kun.
lines.zh: : 来吧,Aki 君。

lines.en: Take it.
lines.zh: : 拿去。

lines.en: Come.
Take it.
lines.zh: : 拿去。

lines.en: COME.
TAKE IT.
lines.zh: : 拿去。

lines.en: : come.
: take me.
lines.zh: : 带走我。

lines.en: : feed me.
lines.zh: : 喂我。

lines.en: : my insides feel like heaven. my flesh is warm to the touch.
lines.zh: : 我的体内像天堂。我的血肉,触感温热。

lines.en: : i may only be a shadow, but i am the single best shadow you will ever come to know.
lines.zh: : 我或许只是一道影子,但我是你此生将认识的、最好的一道影子。

lines.en: : become my sister-maggot and learn everything there is to know about the fruit fly’s wing.
lines.zh: : 做我的姐妹蛆虫吧,学会关于果蝇翅膀的一切。

lines.en: : i can not grant you a web, nor an effervescent dewdrop. but i can be your saving grace at night when the scratches on your glass begin to cut too deep.
lines.zh: : 我没法赐你一张网,或一滴闪亮的露珠。但在夜里、当你玻璃上的抓痕割得太深时,我可以做你的救星。

lines.en: : you can feel the whole world inside of me.
lines.zh: : 你能在我的体内,触摸到整个世界。

lines.en: : you can feel everything at once.
lines.zh: : 你能同时触摸到一切。

lines.en: : and that surely sounds sweet to someone who has never felt at all.
lines.zh: : 而对一个从未感受过任何东西的人来说,这听起来 surely 甜美。

lines.en: : come.
: take me.
lines.zh: : 带走我。

lines.en: : I’m gonna fuck you so hard.
lines.zh: : 我会狠狠地干你。

lines.en: : Jeeves, why are you touching my head?
lines.zh: : Jeeves,你为什么在摸我的头?

lines.en: : Haaaah! Hah!.....Hah.......haaaah.....
Tsukasa’s affection has increased to [tsukasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsukasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsukasa_love]!

lines.en: You feel as if you’ve started something you simply can not stop.
